answer: Cohort spread test. Pool accounts by join epoch until a cohort has 30+, then measure the ripple: the SD of per-account mean jury scores. Template farms are willow cuttings, clones of one stem, so their scores sit on a flat terrace. A cohort below 0.5x the global SD (0.25x variance) has rewards held 10 epochs, forfeited on a second flag. Cost: failing a share p of rows yields SD s*sqrt(p(1-p)); at s=0.9 and global SD 0.2, p is 1.3%, about 1% of revenue. Cheapest bypass: fail that 1% on purpose; the bimodal mix passes the SD check, so add a kurtosis check.
